subject: Request: Identity controls and operational playbook for SSO/SCIM (Triton RFP)
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@tritonfin.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Identity controls and operational playbook for SSO/SCIM (Triton RFP)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As we formalize our RFP response, Triton's security and procurement teams need a concise operational playbook and evidence bundle focused on identity integrations. We are particularly interested in: 

- SSO: SAML v2.0 and OIDC support, IdP-initiated vs SP-initiated flows, assertion attributes, session lifetime controls, step-up MFA integrations.
- SCIM: group and user provisioning, attribute mappings (email, employeeId, title, manager), bulk sync / delta sync cadence, handling of conflicting attributes.
- RBAC & admin controls: built-in roles vs custom roles, delegated admin, MFA for admin portals, admin audit trails.
- Audit & retention: what events are logged, retention periods, export formats, and any SOC2/SOC3 evidence we can reference.

Can you provide a short playbook (2-4 pages) that we can attach to the RFP plus an evidence manifest describing available artifacts? Also let us know expected timeline to finalize and any gaps for regulatory requirements.

We'd like to get this back by EOD Tuesday (6/15) if possible.

Thanks,
Anna Lopez
Head of Security Programs, Triton Financial
anna.lopez@tritonfin.com

[attachment: Triton_RFP_Request_20270610.pdf (pdf)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@tritonfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Identity controls and operational playbook for SSO/SCIM (Triton RFP)

Anna — thanks for the clear ask. We're set up to produce a targeted playbook and an evidence manifest. Quick plan: 

1) Draft playbook (2–3 pages) describing SSO flows (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning model, RBAC patterns, admin delegation, and audit scope.
2) Evidence manifest listing artifacts (SOC2 section references, sample audit export, SCIM attribute map, configuration screenshots).
3) Two short appendices: SCIM attribute map CSV and an operations runbook snippet for group sync failure handling.

I've attached an initial draft and the SCIM attribute map for your review. Ben (security) will attach the audit export sample; Marissa (account lead) will confirm timeline and any contractual needs.

Can you confirm your IdP vendor (Okta / Ping / Azure AD) and whether you prefer SAML-only or to include OIDC? Also, confirm whether you need evidence on data residency/audit retention beyond our standard 13 months.

Attachments: redwood-iam-playbook-draft.pdf (pdf), scim-attribute-map.csv (csv), evidence_manifest.txt (txt)

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Soojin,

Thanks — we received your draft and the CSV. A few quick clarifications before we finalize: 

- IdP: Triton runs Okta currently (we'll need both IdP-initiated SAML and OIDC for some internal apps).
- SCIM cadence: what's your recommended delta sync window for ~25k users and 120 groups? Also how do you handle group membership changes during a partial sync?
- RBAC: can you confirm whether roles can be scoped by tenant (we have multiple legal entities) and whether custom role creation is restricted to org admins only?
- Audit retention: we require a minimum of 12 months of immutable audit events and ability to export in newline-delimited JSON. Does Redwood support immutability guarantees and export via API?

If you can answer those inline and include a short note about any controls that require Dedicated/Private deployments (e.g., data residency or HSM-backed key management), that'd be helpful.

Also attaching a one-page signature form for procurement (we'll need a signed copy).

Best,
Anna
